results.title: What Sleep Apnea Care Needs More of in 2026
results.content: # What Sleep Apnea Care Needs More of in 2026. Here are five areas where sleep apnea care needs to move forward. In 2026, sleep apnea care needs earlier, more proactive screening, particularly for individuals with known risk factors such as obesity, cardiometabolic disease, atrial fibrillation, or chronic lung conditions. Sleep apnea care in 2026 needs clearer, more meaningful patient education—education that explains not just *what* sleep apnea is, but *why* it matters. In 2026, sleep apnea care needs to focus not just on how patients feel, but also on objective risk and physiological impact. Improving sleep apnea care in 2026 will require more than incremental change. At BetterNight, we believe that expanding access through virtual care, home sleep testing, and ongoing patient support is an important part of where sleep apnea care is headed. As sleep medicine continues to evolve, one thing remains clear: improving sleep apnea care means thinking beyond the night—and focusing on the full picture of patient health.
